notes: One object per project in `projects`. Facts carry their source URLs in `sources`. `roleAsStated` quotes the old WordPress site (archive/wordpress/pages/*.md, archive/blog/*.md) word for word; nothing else is a source for roles.

linkStatus values: OK (HTTP 200 at the listed URL), REDIRECT (works, lands elsewhere), BOT-BLOCKED (site refuses automated clients; existence confirmed another way), LOGIN-WALLED, DEAD (with replacement).
cover paths are relative to the repo root. coverShape is landscape unless noted. extraImages are the old-site portrait/banner art copied in.
UNVERIFIED marks anything not confirmed from a live official page or the old site.
Second pass 2026-11-21: projects with "secondPass": true were re-researched; their url, linkStatus, cover, and description supersede the first pass.
